pr.title: Add undo/redo support for Pilot Mode camera movement
pr.body:
<!--
Please target the `master` branch. We will take care of backporting relevant fixes to older versions.

Before submitting, please read our checklist for new contributors:
https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/introduction.html#checklist-for-new-contributors
-->

* Addresses issue brought up for feature added to v4.7: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109945#issuecomment-4397492373

**Note:** The camera transform is committed to the undo/redo manager after 500ms to allow for multiple movement in short sequence without spamming.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7370575d-a179-48cf-8945-1c915462abca
